title: Fintech VIT 3D Vault
oneLiner: A scroll-driven 3D vault journey for the college fintech committee.
claim: Turns a committee page into a journey you move through, and ships every asset inside a budget.

metrics: React Three Fiber over Three.js, driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger
One 1024 px atlas and an instanced city keep the draw call count down
The site ships with a scripted camera audit and a motion diagnostic in CI

media.alt: Cut-out portrait of the author, background removed, in the committee site's member-photography style
media.caption: The committee's own asset export: eleven members cut out to a transparent background.

proof.architecture: A camera path is defined in scroll space and the scene is drawn from it, so the journey is authored once and replayed at any speed. Reduced-motion visitors get cuts instead of sweeps. The same content model also renders as plain HTML, which is why the text is legible with the scene removed.
